reserves.name: U.S. Treasury bills & cash (M0 eligible collateral)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: M0 permissioned minters and eligible collateral SPVs

reserveReview.rationale: Saturn documents USDat's M0-backed mechanics and transparency model. M0 now exposes only the on-chain-indexed Minter Gateway total: its off-chain CollateralCurrent composition feed was retired in August 2026, as recorded in the adapter comment in worker/src/cron/reserve-adapters/m0.ts. The reviewed composition therefore contains one 100% keyed aggregate classified as other because no current cash/Treasury split is published; the former 97.9% tokenized-Treasury / 2.1% cash snapshot is not treated as live. The aggregate is an external M0 reserve envelope rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current M0 Protocol API on-chain-indexed Minter Gateway total combined with Saturn USDat mechanics and transparency documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current M0 source exposes the full aggregate total but not its internal cash/Treasury allocation or minter-level provider shares; the retired 97.9/2.1 composition is not current.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: U.S. Treasury bills & cash (M0 eligible collateral)
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The current M0 aggregate does not identify a tracked reserve asset; the retired itemized feed cannot support an honest coinId link.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Saturn states that USDat capital is in the smart contract but does not publish legal ownership, segregation, insolvency treatment, or rehypothecation terms for the M reserve position.
